name: travel-route-comparator-static-vanilla-js
description: Multi-Modal Commute Comparator & Trail Elevation Tracker built with Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (Zero-Bundler ES Modules) and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const required = ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'server.mjs']; for (const file of required) { if (!fs.existsSync(file)) { throw new Error('Missing required static asset: ' + file); } } console.log('Static Vanilla JS verification passed:', required.join(', ')); })"
